description_en: Queries the deployed applications in the image used by a specified delivery group with paging and returns the number of users with per-application authorization for each application
description_zh: 分页查询指定交付组使用的镜像中已部署的应用，并返回每个应用当前按应用授权的用户数量
name: ListAppsByAppInstanceGroupId

parameters.help_en:
The product type. The value must match the product type of the delivery group specified by AppInstanceGroupId. Otherwise, the error code `InvalidAppInstanceGroup.NotFound` is returned.

Valid values:

CloudApp: WUYING Cloud Application.
CloudBrowser: Cloud Browser
parameters.help_zh:
产品类型。取值需与 AppInstanceGroupId 所指交付组的产品类型一致，否则返回错误码 `InvalidAppInstanceGroup.NotFound`。

取值：

CloudApp：无影云应用。
CloudBrowser：云浏览器
parameters.name: product_type

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from page 1
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从第 1 页开始
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of applications to return per page. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页返回的应用数量。取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The delivery group ID.

WUYING Cloud Application delivery group: call the [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the ID.
Cloud Browser group: specify the Cloud Browser group ID. Call the [ListBrowserInstanceGroup](~~ListBrowserInstanceGroup~~) operation to obtain the ID.

This parameter is required. If it is not specified, the error code `InvalidParameter.AppInstanceGroupId` is returned
parameters.help_zh:
交付组 ID。

无影云应用交付组：可调用 [ListAppInstanceGroup](~~ListAppInstanceGroup~~) 接口获取。
云浏览器组：传入云浏览器组 ID，可调用 [ListBrowserInstanceGroup](~~ListBrowserInstanceGroup~~) 接口获取。

该参数必须传入。未传入时返回错误码 `InvalidParameter.AppInstanceGroupId`
parameters.name: app_instance_group_id

Apps.description_en: The list of application information on the current page. This is an empty list if no deployed applications exist in the delivery group image
Apps.description_zh: 当前页的应用信息列表。交付组镜像中没有已部署的应用时为空列表

AppIcon.description_en: The URL of the application icon

AppId.description_en: The application ID. Pass in this value when you call the [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) operation to authorize users for this application
AppId.description_zh: 应用 ID。调用 [AuthorizeUsersForApp](~~AuthorizeUsersForApp~~) 接口为该应用授权用户时，传入此值

AuthorizedUserCount.description_en: The number of users currently authorized by application for this application in the delivery group. The value 0 is returned if no users are authorized by application
AuthorizedUserCount.description_zh: 该应用当前在交付组内按应用授权的用户数量。未按应用授权任何用户时返回 0

PageNumber.description_en: The current page number, which is the same as the PageNumber request parameter
PageNumber.description_zh: 当前页码，与请求参数 PageNumber 一致

PageSize.description_en: The number of applications returned per page, which is the same as the PageSize request parameter
PageSize.description_zh: 每页返回的应用数量，与请求参数 PageSize 一致

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of deployed applications in the delivery group
TotalCount.description_zh: 该交付组内已部署应用的总数
